scope: Technique-level installed Processing JAVA2D GrainMarks on CP5 public sampling, with supplied triangles and CP4 cell transfer. No original-source pixel reproduction, shader/P3D/other-target or whole-corpus claim.

observations.base: Fine blue point texture fills the supplied triangle fairly evenly; the canvas around it stays light.
observations.palette: Coral dots retain the same texture positions; palette-dots returns to this appearance after the stroke toggle.
observations.palette-strokes: Horizontal coral strokes give much stronger visible texture while retaining point centres.
observations.denser: The same triangle has visibly more blue grain; native checks prove the lower count is an exact prefix.
observations.vertex: Clear dark concentration near the first vertex at bottom-left, fading toward the opposite side.
observations.edge: A subtler uneven distribution across the triangle, distinct from uniform and first-vertex cases.
observations.cells: All triangular cell regions carry fine grain; the coloured boundaries remain delicate in dot mode.
observations.cells-palette: Colour changes while retaining cell point geometry; fine dots remain pale.
observations.cells-strokes: The horizontal coloured strokes make the entire cell/triangle structure clearly legible.
observations.resets: Root inspected palette-dots, style-reset, density-reset, distribution-reset and all-reset as well; baseline resets agree visually and native pixel equality passed.
observations.seed-43: Point arrangement changes while the supplied triangle remains the same shape.

limitations: Dots are intentionally delicate at this example setting; stroke substitution provides the clearest regional reading.
This is an installed JAVA2D technique demonstration with independently specified streams/arithmetic, not a source-pixel reproduction.
No original survey PNGs were inspected or diffed in this acceptance.
No human artist usability session or other-target port validation is claimed.
